behaviors.name: Read the top items
behaviors.does: Asks the feed for its top list, then each item in turn, and gives back each item's id, title, text and where the text came from.
refusals: the feed's top list does not load: rejects with a Refusal
error_handling: an item that fails to load rejects the whole read

quotes.what: the refusal when the feed does not answer
quotes.text: I cannot read the news feed right now. Nothing was written.

quotes.what: the reply when the feed is down
quotes.text: I could not read the feed.

rules.rule: An item's text is its article, else its summary, else its comments joined with line breaks.
At most 25 items are read, whatever count asks for.
Each request is given up after 8000 milliseconds.
Every request sends the user agent news-agent/1.0 and accepts JSON.

behaviors.name: Read the news as a command
behaviors.does: Reads the flags and the message, answers a stop notice without reading, reads the top items, writes out/top.json and prints one JSON reply.
outputs: a JSON reply on standard output
refusals: a stop notice: nothing is read or written
error_handling: any other error is thrown again

rules.rule: The stop notice is checked before anything is read.

behaviors.name: Recognize the stop notice
behaviors.does: Gives back the job a stop notice names, or null when the text is not one.

behaviors.name: Answer a stop notice
behaviors.does: Gives back the one sentence a stop notice is answered with, naming the job.

quotes.text: Nothing was running for ${job}, so nothing was done.

behaviors.name: Get JSON
behaviors.does: Fetches one address and parses its JSON.

kind.why: plain node scripts and an agent descriptor

parts.name: news reader
parts.does: reads the feed and writes the items

parts.name: stop notice
parts.does: recognizes and answers the runner's stop notice

systems.name: http-api
systems.why: the top list and each item are fetched

networks.destination: the news feed at the address in FEED
networks.why: fetched for the top list and items

interfaces.name: out/top.json
interfaces.does: The items read, in the feed's order

id.description: the item's id as the feed gives it

interfaces.name: readTop
interfaces.does: Reads the top items of the feed
interfaces.returns: a promise of the list of items, each with id, title, text and text_from

interfaces.name: read-news
interfaces.does: Reads the news and prints one JSON reply
